name: @alb233/dsh-error-monitor

scripts.check: node tools/check-locale-keys.mjs && node tools/check-error-hints.mjs && node tools/check-repair-commands.mjs && node tools/check-fix-marker.mjs && node tools/check-subagent-prompts.mjs && node tools/check-main-hints.mjs && node tools/check-client-load.mjs

description: Lists this session's failures as copyable cards in the conversation view, attributes each to a cause, and carries the next step: fix the cause in place, copy paste-ready repair commands, or mark it resolved — the panel ticks itself off once a verified fix is reported.
